method: Dense 6-frame contact sheets generated via ffmpeg from original source videos, visually inspected frame-by-frame
v0024_v0026_editorial_note: Excluded from deep review per Jane's editorial decision (2026-09-02). V0024/V0026 are not final-video A-roll candidates. Their transcripts remain project-intelligence sources.

summary.what_the_strongest_media_can_show: The strongest available footage clearly demonstrates: (1) the scale and curvature of the completed 106-foot curved LED wall with live multi-source sports content, (2) the bar ticker integrated into the sportsbook bar environment with patrons present, (3) the installation process with technicians working on lifts during the build, (4) the decommissioned legacy projectors removed from the rack room, and (5) the overall finished sportsbook environment with patrons using the space. The footage is heavily weighted toward completed hero reveals of the finished wall from multiple angles, with strong installation progress and decommissioning coverage.
summary.what_is_missing: No footage of the 2 LUCI racks that replaced the 15 legacy racks (only the 'before' decommissioning footage exists). No footage of the LUCI interface/iPad in operational use. No footage of wall configurations being switched. No customer/operator interview. No true 'before' footage of the old projector/screen sportsbook in operation (V0048 shows decommissioned projectors in storage, not the former setup running). No footage of the bar ticker under construction.
